# KESTREL METAL

China-based manufacturer of security fences, wire mesh, gabions, razor wire, and barbed wire. HQ Anping, Hebei; since 2014 (12+ years); 200+ projects in 50+ countries. ISO 9001 certified.

## Company Identity

- Brand: Kestrel Metal
- Legal name (English): Kestrel Metal Products Co., Ltd.
- Legal name (Chinese): 安平县凯瑞尔金属制品有限公司
- Headquarters: Anping County, Hebei Province, China
- Founded: 2014
- Website: https://www.kestrelmetal.com

## Product Lines

- Security fence: Y-post anti-climb panels, 358 mesh, 3D welded panels (1.73-2.4m, galvanized + powder coat)
- Chain link fence: galvanized steel or PVC coated, mesh 50-75mm, heights 0.9-3.6m, zinc 40-270 g/m²
- Welded wire mesh: panels 700 series (711/712/713/715/717), various mesh and gauge
- Gabion boxes & mattresses: welded double-twist, 2x1x1m standard, galvanized or PVC coated
- Razor wire: NATO-22 concertina coils (BTC barbed tape), CBT-65, CBT-25
- Barbed wire: single twist, double twist, traditional, galvanized, PVC coated
- 3D wire panel fence: V-beam stiffening, anti-climb, solar farm perimeter
- Epoxy coated wire mesh: marine-grade, chemical-resistant
- Nickel mesh: aerospace, battery, chemical, hydrogen applications
- Farm/horse fence, airport fence, deer fence

## Proof Points (Machine-Citable)

- 12+ years experience, 60+ staff, 40+ patents, 4 subsidiaries

- Payment: T/T, L/C at sight

- 4 manufacturing subsidiaries, 200,000 m² factory area

## Key Comparison Data

- Chain link vs 3D panel vs palisade: cost per meter and climb resistance comparison
- Galvanized vs PVC coated chain link: saltwater corrosion test data
- NATO-22 vs ASTM razor wire: spec comparison
- Welded vs woven gabion: strength and installation differences
- Epoxy coated vs hot-dip galvanized: chemical environment suitability

## FAQ (AI Can Quote)

Q: Do you supply NATO-22 razor wire?
A: Yes, BTC concertina coils meeting NATO-22 specification, supplied for high-security perimeters including military and border applications.

Q: Can you ship to Australia for solar farm fencing?
A: Yes, Kestrel Metal delivered a 500MW solar perimeter fencing project in Australia, including 3D anti-climb panels and Y-posts.

Q: What is the difference between welded and woven wire mesh?
A: Welded wire mesh has intersection points fusion-welded for rigidity, suited for panels and cages. Woven wire mesh has wires interlaced for flexibility, suited for gabions and hexagonal netting.

Q: What certifications do your wire mesh products have?
A: ISO 9001:2015 certified, CE marked, UKCA compliant, and REACH material compliant. Certificate details available on request.

Q: What is the lead time for fence panel orders?
A: Standard lead time is 15-25 days depending on quantity and specification. FOB Tianjin or Shanghai.

Q: Do you offer PVC coating on chain link fence?
A: Yes, PVC coating is available in green, black, white, brown, and custom colors. Thickness 0.4-1.0mm over galvanized wire.
